report.summary: Vulture: static Python analysis, high false positives (50-80% typical in dynamic codebases due to reflection/eval). Coverage-guided: false positive rate depends on test coverage; with 80% line coverage, ~20% of uncovered lines may be live but untested. Meta's tool (production tracing + shadow testing): removed 2.5M lines with zero reported incidents, effectively 0% FP rate (PyCon 2019 talk). Most actionable: instrument production with sampling to log executed functions/lines, then prune with confidence.

handoff.suggestion: Implement production sampling of function/line execution using a low-overhead tracer (e.g., sys.settrace or bytecode injection) to gather real-world coverage data over weeks; use this to safely identify dead code with near-zero false positives, similar to Meta's approach.
